svg.title: From paths to resources
svg.desc: RapiMock reads the paths of an OpenAPI spec: the /pets operations become the Pet resource with its key and actions, /owners/{ownerId} the Owner resource it links to, and POST /login stays static.
svg.text: RapiMock reads the data model off the spec, and labels every operation.

g.text: Seeded pets belong to seeded owners

svg.text: so it answers with the spec's example.
